quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: On a crosswalk.

activation.condition: Vehicle stops, stands or parks on a source-reviewed crosswalk.

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park on a crosswalk unless an exact source exception applies.

exceptions.trigger: Necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
exceptions.effect: The prohibition has an exception when necessity is established from original traffic evidence.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain the original traffic evidence for independent review.
exceptions.source_clause: except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic

exceptions.effect: The prohibition has an exception when another law actually requires the activity.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain the source authority for independent review.

exceptions.effect: The prohibition has an exception when an actual police direction applies.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain original officer direction evidence for review.
exceptions.source_clause: the directions of a police officer

exceptions.effect: The prohibition has an exception when an official device direction applies.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain original device authority and indication evidence for review.

timing.description: Observe the complete interval of stopping, standing or parking on the crosswalk.
